dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Permisi, ada yang bisa saya bantu? Anda tampak tersesat.
dialogue.en: Excuse me, can I help you? You look lost.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Ya, tolong. Di mana stasiun? Apakah jauh?

dialogue.speaker: Dewi

dialogue.en: No, it is not far. Go straight ahead for two streets.
